CA.name: American pennyroyal
CA.citation: Native range confirmed from Nova Scotia and southern Quebec/Ontario west to Minnesota (FSUS). Deliberately disambiguated from bare 'pennyroyal', which is also used for the unrelated, similarly toxic European Mentha pulegium - a confusion documented as longstanding even among 19th-century medical writers (Henriette's Herbal, citing Rafinesque). 'Squaw-mint', though historically documented, is excluded per this project's standing convention on such terms

DE.name: Amerikanische Poleiminze
DE.citation: kraeuterallerlei.de, explicitly distinguishing the cultivated annual 'Amerikanische Poleiminze' (H. pulegioides) from the perennial European 'Poleiminze' (Mentha pulegium); cross-confirmed by USDA phytochemical/ethnobotanical database (phytochem.nal.usda.gov)

US.name: American pennyroyal
US.citation: National Park Service NPSpecies records (multiple parks); Drugs.com clinical monograph. SAFETY: pulegone content is hepatotoxic, neurotoxic and a documented abortifacient in concentrated/oil form; internal use of the essential oil is not recommended
